limitations: The paper’s Compustat vintage and original firm-level random split seed are unavailable. A3 has 26,236 final firm-years versus 22,113 reported and 13,175 exploratory rows versus 11,061; counts are not forced. Target years begin in 1988 but the realized complete-history sample begins in 1991. A bounded coordinator audit with identical annual selectors confirms OANCF has zero observed values in 1983–1986 and 785 in 1987; the five-year CFO history requirement therefore rules out target years 1988–1990. The audit reproduces the SAS current-item-complete total 94,766 for 1984–2004. The wider sample-count gap remains unresolved; no CFO proxy is introduced. Audit: output/reproduction_runs/preflight/volatility_cashflow_coverage.json.

The paper does not specify the principal OLS covariance correction; conventional OLS standard errors are used. Native t-tests are two-sided; the reported table states p<0.001 but does not state sidedness.
The paper does not specify the percentile implementation or how tied volatility values are assigned to quintiles; pooled cutoffs and PROC RANK defaults are used.
Table 2 Panel B does not report per-quintile N. Horizon-specific regression Ns are exported for comparison; the published Table 3 and Table 4 counts are the available checks.

Supporting adjusted-R-squared tests use 1,000 row-level pseudo-quintile assignments over the local exploratory sample with a fixed seed; the paper describes this row-level unit but its sample has 11,061 observations. The original simulation seed is unreported. Both one-sided and two-sided empirical tails are logged; the final zero-hit tail estimate is limited by 1,000 repetitions.

A3 replaces A2’s CURRTR multiplication with the provider-documented own-DATADATE daily GBP cross-rate for non-USD assets. Among current-ratio-complete CAD rows, 372 meet A2’s $100m threshold but not A3’s; none move in the reverse direction. The source contains 123 known current/prior CURCD changes and no unknown currency-code pairs among matched years; those ratios are unavailable. Separate valid dimensionless lead ratios are not screened for current/lead currency equality.
